# U134: Proposed, then active: as Tunde, New goal’s last step asks “Is it under way?”; “Not yet: propose it” turns the button to “Propose goal” and the block to “After you propose it”; the goal has a key and a page that says “Proposed” as a word with no status shape; Goals, Mine counts it apart (“· 1 proposed”) and the link lists it; with the filter the Board is one column, Proposed, and the Map draws it dashed with the word; its check-in says there is nothing to check in; a fortnight later it still says “Proposed”. As Oskar its page has comment, ask and watch and “Tunde Bakare or an admin can make this active.” As Tunde, “Make it active” reads back From as this week with the first check-in’s date; after it the page reads “No check-in yet”; Undo returns it to proposed; made active again, the “…” menu’s “Make it proposed again” asks and returns it to proposed; “Withdraw it” removes it

- **Belongs to:** the Goal map module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `GOAL-PROPOSED`, `NEW-GOAL-STEPS`
- **Budget:** at most 40 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Tunde, at `/goals/new?today={day}` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 6282

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Tunde (`tunde`).
- Go to `/goals/new?today={day}` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/what”.
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- **Step.** Type “Signed artifacts in staging” into the “Name it the way” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/who”.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- **Step.** Type “%” into the “Unit” field.
- **Step.** Type “40” into the “Baseline” field.
- **Step.** Type “90” into the “Target” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
- **Check:** “Is it under way?” is shown (else: the last step doesn’t ask whether the goal is under way).
- **Step.** Press the “Not yet: propose it” choice in the “Is it under way?” group.
- **Check:** “After you propose it” is shown (else: “Not yet” doesn’t turn the block to “After you propose it”).
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Propose goal” button is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “check”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Propose goal” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/…?…published=1”.
- **Check:** The goal proposed (`.goal-proposed`) shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if the proposed goal’s page doesn’t say “Proposed” above the title.
- **Check:** (`a11y`) a status shape in the goal proposed (`.goal-proposed`) is not there (else: a proposed goal’s page draws a status shape).
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if the proposed goal was saved without a key or without proposedAt.
- _Note:_ Goals, Mine counts it apart, and the link lists it.
- Go to `/goals?scope=mine&today={day}` in the demo.
- **Check:** The Goals count line shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if Goals, Mine reads “{line.innerText()}”, not “· 1 proposed”.
- **Step.** Press the “1 proposed” link in the Goals count line.
- **Check:** “1 proposed goal, newest first.” is shown (else: the proposed link doesn’t list it).

- **Check:** (`a11y`) the status shape in the proposed rows (`.proposed-rows .status-shape`) is not there (else: a proposed row draws a status shape).
- _Note:_ The Board with the filter: one column, Proposed, with its card; the Map: its node dashed, with the word.

- **Check:** The part `section.board-col[aria-label="Proposed, 1"]` shows.

- **Check:** (`a11y`) a status shape in the part `section.board-col[aria-label="Proposed, 1"]` is not there (else: a proposed card on the Board draws a status shape).
- Go to `/goals?scope=mine&state=proposed&view=map&today={day}` in the demo.

- **Check:** (`a11y`) a status shape in the map node proposed (`.map-node.proposed`) is not there (else: a proposed node on the Map draws a status shape).
- Go to `/goals?scope=mine&view=list&today={day}` in the demo.

- Go to `/check-in/{id}?today={day}` in the demo.
- **Check:** “This goal is proposed, so there is nothing to check in. Make it active first.” is shown (else: the check-in of a proposed goal doesn’t say so).

- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if a fortnight later it no longer says Proposed.

- **Step.** Press the “Make it active” button in the goal proposed (`.goal-proposed`).
- **Step.** Press the “Make it active” button in the make active (`.make-active`).
